limitations: Post-inference source-correspondence audit, not blinded or independent clinical validation.

Reader11 records directory and predecessor reviewer-1 filename search contained no records for these six PMIDs on arrival; queue records existing_main_text_read=false. No predecessor reading credit invented. Curated subscription inputs were prepared but Claude used zero tokens and performed no review.

Main text and 44 references fully read from the public author-uploaded article. All four main publisher figure images and all four publisher HTML tables read, including table footnotes. Table pixel coverage uses offline UTF-8 rendering of the actual publisher table markup, not the unavailable typeset PDF. All three supplement tables read as text and pixels. Initial mojibake table renders were retained for provenance but are not reading evidence.

Source TableS3 titled RawData actually reports five mean±error summaries, not replicate-level measurements. MainTable3 W240S normalized activity5% does not transparently reconcile its negative background-corrected activity row; retained as source limitation, not corrected.
Publisher Table3 footnote points to Figure1d for cell-surface processing, whereas the corresponding plotted panel is Figure2d; this source cross-reference anomaly is retained without correction.
